key.label: {{provider}} API key
key.stored: Stored on {{computer}} only. It is never shown again.
key.stopWarn: Stop tracking only if it did not go through.
key.pendingHint: The key is not kept if you close this. To retry, stop tracking this save and type the key again.
key.refusedTitle: The key was refused. Nothing was saved.
key.changed: This provider changed while you were saving. Close this and reopen it.
key.stillNot: Still not confirmed. Check again, or type the key again.
key.notConfirmed: The key may have been saved. Check before typing it again.
key.saveUnproved: Check again cannot tell whether this save went through.
key.held: Nothing was sent: another change to the {{provider}} key on this computer may still be going through. Check it on the AI page.
key.notHeld: Nothing was sent: this browser could not keep track of the save. Try again in a moment.
key.leftRefused: {{provider}} refused the key you sent. Nothing was saved.
key.leftFailed: The {{provider}} key you sent wasn't saved.
key.leftBody: Open the {{provider}} setup again and enter a working key.
gpt.steps: Open the page, then enter this code.
gpt.codeHint: Type it on the page that opens. It is hidden when you leave this step.
gpt.noLink: The sign-in page is shown by ChatGPT. Open it yourself and enter the code.
gpt.waiting: Waiting for you to finish signing in
gpt.unconfirmedTitle: The sign-in may have gone through
gpt.expired: The code ran out. Start again for a new one.
left.title: The {{provider}} sign-in may have gone through
left.body: You left it before its cancel was confirmed. Check again before you sign in again.
or.step2: Approve the request. OpenRouter then opens a localhost page that does not load. That is expected.
or.step3: Copy that page's whole address from the address bar and paste it below.
or.noLink: The sign-in link cannot be opened from here. Try again for a new one.
or.paste: Address of the page that did not load
or.pasteHint: It starts with localhost and holds a sign-in code. It is sent once and never shown here.
or.noCode: That address holds no sign-in code. Copy the whole address of the page that did not load.
or.key: That looks like an API key. Paste the page address here, or go back and choose Use an API key.
or.minutes: The sign-in stays open for 15 minutes.
or.error: OpenRouter did not finish the sign-in.
or.unsupported: This computer cannot sign in to OpenRouter yet. Go back and use an API key.
or.codeFailed: OpenRouter didn't take that address. Paste it again.
ep.changed: {{endpoint}} changed since this step opened. Read it again, then enter the key again.
